items.name: larson-scanner
items.title: Knight Rider — Larson Scanner
items.description: A programmable sci-fi light scanner with six motion patterns, custom paths, color and voice controls, complete reduced-motion behavior, and touch-safe programming.
items.author: Scott E. Telling
items.docs: Import LarsonScanner from your components/ui folder. Sound starts muted. The canvas freezes every time-based effect for reduced motion and pauses when the element is offscreen. The purpose-built light belongs inside the scanner frame; do not spread its glow into surrounding product chrome.
